_about: Single source for every number and link on the page. The build step injects these values; nothing on the page is typed by hand. Re-verify each entry with its _source before anything goes public.

fyt.name: Fyt
fyt.tagline: Social fitness app for iPhone and Apple Watch

_sources.users: read-only query of the production database counting app users, excluding the developer's own account; 379 on 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24
_sources.commits_since_2026_05_01: git rev-list --count HEAD --since=2026-05-01 in the Fyt repository (3425 on 2026-09-23; first commit is 2026-05-01)
_sources.swiftui_files: Swift files importing SwiftUI in the Fyt iOS app (283 on 2026-09-23)
_sources.stack: the Fyt API's package.json (fastify, drizzle-orm, pg-boss) and its Fly.io config
_sources.updates_since_launch: the App Store listing's version history: 25 releases from 1.0.17 (2026-07-07) to 1.0.43 (2026-09-21), after the launch release; re-check by counting the listing's dated version entries
_sources.chat_posts, chat_posts_since: read-only query of the production database: announcements with sent_to_imessage_at set (count, earliest date); 438 since 2026-05-09 on 2026-09-24
_sources.background_upload_since: version 1.0.43 release notes and App Store listing: a run finished on the Watch reaches Fyt in the background; only workouts recorded by Fyt's own Watch app

menus.name: Multilingual QR menus
menus.tagline: Scan-to-open menus guests read in their own language

_sources.brands: the menu build repository: one directory per brand with a pdf/ folder (8 on 2026-09-23)
_sources.languages, language_names: the language list in the menu build's shared build module
_sources.live_url: the live menus; James asked on 2026-09-23 (evening) for the menu pictures to link here, replacing the earlier no-link decision
_sources.started: first commit of the menu repository: git log --reverse --format=%ad --date=short main | head -1
_sources.allergens, allergen_names: the allergens list in every brand's menu data (structure.json), the same in all eight
_sources.pdfs: published PDF menus in the menu repository: every <brand>/pdf/*.pdf, 195 on 2026-09-24 (brands with more than one menu edition have one PDF per edition per language)

_sources.menu_from, website_from: James's prices (Ladder B, set 2026-09-23); shown as 'from' prices on the page by his decision of 2026-09-24

_sources.github: not linked from the page: James decided on 2026-09-23 to leave GitHub off
_sources.upwork: not linked: James decided on 2026-09-23 to leave Upwork out
